source_preview:
Job Description: Java Full Stack Developer
Experience: 3-5 Years
Location: Mumbai
Notice period-   Immediate to 45 days
Employment Type: Full-Time
Key Responsibilities:

•
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance applications.

•
Develop back-end components using Java, Node.js, and databases like MongoDB,
MySQL, or PostgreSQL.

•
Build responsive and dynamic front-end applications using Flutter, Ionic, Vue.js, or
React.

•
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.

•
Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.

•
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software.

•
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and best practices.
Key Result Areas (KRAs):

•
Timely delivery of high-quality software modules.

•
Effective collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

•
Continuous improvement in application performance and user experience.

•
Adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

•
Code quality and maintainability metrics.

•
On-time completion of development tasks and projects.

•
Number of critical bugs identified post-deployment.

•
User feedback on application performance and usability.
Required Skills:

•
Strong proficiency in Java and Node.js.

•
Experience with databases: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL.

•
Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks: Flutter, Ionic, Vue.js, React.


•
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.

•
Proficiency in version control tools like Git.

•
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Preferred Skills:

•
Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) is an added advantage.

•
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

•
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Education

•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
